title: FINCOSMOS: An Open-World Evaluation Paradigm for Agents in Finance
title_zh: FINCOSMOS：面向金融智能体的开放世界评估范式

paragraphs.en: FINCOSMOS提出金融智能体开放世界评估范式，通过程序校验与否决检查揭示智能体的静默失败。 Language agents increasingly work for users on the open Web, and finance is where trusting them is hardest. The data must come from the Web, the strategy lives in the user's head, and correctness depends on time, so an agent can fail silently: a strategy the user never asked for, unverified data, or a backtest that uses the future yields a report as convincing as a correct one. Existing benchmarks close the world somewhere, fixing the task, the data, or the timeline, and thereby remove these failures instead of measuring them. We introduce FINCOSMOS, an open-world evaluation paradigm for agents doing financial work. A simulated user holds a hidden strategy sampled from a compositional grammar and reveals it only when asked. The agent receives no data, so it must acquire data from the Web, build its own backtest under a data cutoff, and deliver verifiable results. Grading needs no reference answer. Programs verify point-in-time correctness and recompute every reported metric, the delivered strategy is checked against the hidden specification, and a run is accepted only when the user is satisfied and none of 15 veto checks fails. Across four coding agents and a model without tools in 150 sessions, no session is accepted: every session that the simulated user signed off fails a program check, and agents raise only 54--64\% of the details they were not told. Human experts attribute 88.33\% of failures to the agents. With FINCOSMOS feedback, an agent with persistent memory learned all ten tasks.
paragraphs.zh: FINCOSMOS提出了金融智能体的开放世界评估范式，通过程序校验与否决检查来揭示智能体的静默失败。语言智能体日益在开放网络上为用户工作，而金融领域正是最难信任它们的地方。 数据必须来自网络，策略只存在于用户的头脑中，而正确性又依赖于时间，因此智能体可能静默失败：用户从未要求过的策略、未经验证的数据，或使用了未来数据的回测，都会产出与正确报告同样令人信服的结果。 现有基准总在某个地方封闭世界，固定任务、数据或时间线，从而消除了这些失败，而非度量它们。 我们提出FINCOSMOS，一个面向金融工作的智能体开放世界评估范式。 一个模拟用户持有从组合文法中采样的隐藏策略，且只在被问及时才予以透露。 智能体不会收到任何数据，因此它必须从网络获取数据，在数据截止点约束下构建自己的回测，并交付可验证的结果。 评分无需参考答案。 程序验证时点正确性并重新计算每一个报告的指标，交付的策略会与隐藏规格进行比对，只有当用户满意且15项否决检查全部通过时，一次运行才会被接受。 在四个编码智能体和一个无工具模型共150次会话中，没有任何会话被接受：模拟用户签署认可的每一次会话都未通过程序检查，而智能体仅主动获知了它们未被明确告知的细节中的54%–64%。 人类专家将88.33%的失败归因于智能体。 借助FINCOSMOS的反馈，一个具有持久记忆的智能体学会了全部十项任务。
